name: vedit
description: Edit video in your open VEdit editor using natural language: trim, arrange, add text and sound effects, then export on your device.

interface.longDescription: Control your paired local VEdit timeline and export MP4 on your device. Keep the editor open while using the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use VEdit to trim my video and add a title.
Use VEdit to add a pop sound at 3 seconds.
